answer: Paired-receipt bond blocks mass fake identities. Each identity locks 70 and files a pair: a lantern-stamped receipt plus its mirror twin, witness-signed. Auditors sample one in ten pairs, checking both halves in the lantern ledger. A hollow pair, one half forged, fails, and a reused mirror twin burns the bond. First pair 48, k-th 48+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,545,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 48 once and keep the bond.
